scheme_name: Student Housing Scheme for Students with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student with disability of 40% or more
Applicant must have passed Higher Secondary Examination
Applicant must be enrolled as a regular student in a College, Polytechnic, or ITI and not be failing in any academic session
Distance between applicant's original residence and the educational institution must exceed 20 kilometers
Applicants must form a group of up to five eligible disabled students
benefits_summary: Free accommodation for up to five disabled students with rent capped up to ₹10,000, ₹7,000 or ₹5,000 per month depending on city category.
documents_required: Disability certificate issued by the medical board for each student
Distance certificate issued by the Sarpanch, Panch, Municipal Corporation, Municipality, or Nagar Panchayat confirming distance >20 km
